title: Factor difference of squares
text: Factor $$x^2-1=\left(x-1\right) \left(x+1\right)$$ by recognizing a difference of squares.

title: Cancel common factors
text: Notice the common factors of $$x$$ and $$x+1$$, which we can factor because we are given that these quantities are nonzero.\n\n$$\frac{x^2-1}{x} \frac{x}{x+1}=\frac{\left(x-1\right) \left(x+1\right)}{x} \frac{x}{x+1}=\frac{x-1}{1}=x-1$$
